# Maschina

> Give software a job and money, safely, so it can go to work for you. Built on Solana.

A machine on Maschina is a piece of software with its own Solana wallet, a budget it cannot exceed, rules it
cannot break, and a permanent record of every decision. Its funds can only ever go back to the wallet that
made it. The first machines trade: ranges that buy dips and sell rises, price triggers, and more, each set
once and left to run. Paper machines are free and trade against real prices without moving money.

- App: https://maschina.dev
- Docs: https://docs.maschina.dev
- Source: https://github.com/maschina-labs/maschina
- Whitepaper: https://maschina.dev/whitepaper.pdf
- Papers, fifteen of them, from the primer to the risk disclosures: https://maschina.dev/papers/index.pdf
